description: Instrument run with no recipe change, and the baseline for every following idea. The tip is E100 code (176e5ec). Its two distinct scored samples are 0.7561 and 0.7516, and its only off-seed sample is one process (22 seeds, 0.7523). E098 showed that one process per arm cannot resolve 0.1 pp. In an untimed side script, run the unchanged E100 code through the benchmark's own trial code on seeds 3-26 in 2 more fresh processes, so cuDNN picks are resampled. Do not edit benchmark/. Log per-seed accuracy, per-seed final-weight checksums and the cuDNN conv kernel names per (layer, shape); the kernel names are the free by-product for H4.5.1. For the scored row, rerun E100 unchanged; a non-bit-identical result adds a third distinct scored sample. Store the pooled 24-seed vectors (>=2 distinct processes) as the paired baseline for every later off-seed A/B.
